- Is a Waiver of Subrogation required in favor of Redwood?

Subject: Re: Submission: COI + completed risk questionnaire for Redwood PO

Hi Liam —

Received, thanks — the COI and questionnaire look good as a starting point. A few procurement / risk items we need to close before issuing the PO:

1) Endorsements we require on the insurer's form or equivalent endorsement letter:
   - Additional Insured (AI) in favor of: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and affiliates" — naming Redwood specifically on the endorsement is preferred.
   - Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood on General Liability and Auto.
   - Primary & Noncontributory language where the insurer confirms coverage will be primary and not seek contribution from Redwood's carriers.
2) Certificate holder info for our records (please list exactly):
   Redwood Inference
   Attn: Vendor Onboarding
   2150 Bryant St, Suite 300
   San Francisco, CA 94110
3) Please include a completed W-9 (for US vendors) and remittance information for PO payment.
4) If Tidewater uses a Third-Party Administrator (TPA) for claims handling, please provide TPA contact and claim submission details.

Note: We can provisionally reserve a PO number (see below). However, issuance of a finalized, payable PO is contingent on receipt of the endorsements above (or an insurer letter confirming they will issue them).

I'll loop in Risk for a quick review if HarborPoint can provide the endorsements. Ben — I flagged this as high priority for the integration timeline; we expect to get Tidewater onboarded within 1-2 business days of the final doc set.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@tidewaterai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@tidewaterai.com
Date: 2026-09-13T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Submission: COI + completed risk questionnaire for Redwood PO

Grace —

Thanks for the clarity. Quick answers and a couple of constraints from HarborPoint:
- HarborPoint can provide a Blanket Additional Insured endorsement for operations and ongoing services; they prefer issuing blanket language tied to policy rather than a schedule naming each client. Is a blanket AI acceptable for Redwood's use-case or do you require the policy to specifically name "Redwood Inference, Inc."?
- Waiver of Subrogation: HarborPoint can issue this in most cases, we should be able to get it added.
- Primary & Noncontributory: HarborPoint has flagged that providing full primary & noncontributory language is underwritten on a case-by-case basis. If they can't do full primary & noncontributory, they can provide a carrier statement confirming the intent but it may not read as explicit primary language.

I attached a short letter from HarborPoint summarizing what they can commit to today. If Redwood needs a named endorsement, we can ask HarborPoint for a scheduled endorsement naming Redwood specifically (this can add 3-5 business days).

Attachments:
- TPL_endorsement_letter.pdf

Would Redwood accept a blanket AI plus a carrier statement for primary intent as interim evidence while we work on a scheduled endorsement?

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Liam

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@tidewaterai.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Submission: COI + completed risk questionnaire for Redwood PO

Hi Liam / Grace —

Quick alignment from our side so Tidewater can keep onboarding progress moving:
- For standard integrations, a Blanket Additional Insured endorsement for operations/services is typically acceptable for issuing a conditional PO; for any contracts involving data hosting or engineering-run integrations we prefer a scheduled (named) AI. If HarborPoint can confirm blanket AI applies to "services and operations" including engineering work, that should work for the initial PO.
- Waiver of Subrogation + certificate holder as requested — yes, required.
- Primary & Noncontributory: if HarborPoint can provide a carrier statement of intent to be primary as an interim step, Risk (Mina) will accept that while a scheduled endorsement is in process. If HarborPoint cannot provide any primary language, we'll need Legal review which could add time.

Operationally we've reserved PO number PO-98742 for Tidewater (status: pending docs). Once we have the AI (blanket or scheduled), waiver, and W-9, procurement will issue the formal PO within 2 business days.

Attaching a stub to indicate the reserved PO record in our system.

Attachment:
- Reserved_PO_PO-98742_stub.txt
